objective.statement: Add a "page views by day" summary, in its own panel on the page, showing how many times the page was viewed on each of the last 7 days.

complexity.rationale: New pure helper, persisted store state and a new component; no external contract or dependency.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The home page renders its own "Page views by day" panel.
The panel lists the last 7 days (today and the 6 days before), one row per day, with the view count for that day; days without views show 0.
Loading the app records one page view for the current day, and counts persist across reloads.

in.statement: A pure per-day counting helper, page view state in the Zustand app store persisted to localStorage, a PageViewsPanel component shown in HomeView, and colocated tests.

out.statement: Header or footer placement, today-only or all-time views, server-side analytics, charts, new dependencies, pruning of old stored days.

observations.statement: The repository has no backend or analytics source. A page view is one load of the app in this browser, counted per local calendar day and stored in localStorage under ada-test-app:pageViewsByDay.
Client-side route changes do not count as views; only app loads do. The panel is shown on the home page only. Days are keyed by local date (YYYY-MM-DD) and listed oldest first, with today last.

provenance.source: New Feature request and owner answers placement (Its own panel on the page), period (Last 7 days, shown per day)

capabilityOwners.rationale: Panel is presentational; no local state.
Per-day counts are app-wide client state persisted like theme and dark mode.
No remote data in this slice.

unit.rationale: Day keys, counting and the 7-day window are isolated logic; store load recording and persistence.

component.rationale: Panel rendering and its placement in HomeView are component behaviour.

integration.rationale: npm run test run as regression.

e2e.rationale: No new user flow; panel is read-only.

increments.behavior: Pure helpers: toDayKey, incrementDay, lastDays (7 entries oldest first, zero-filled).
The app store records one view per load, persists the counts, and restores them.
PageViewsPanel shows the last 7 days with counts and is rendered in HomeView.
increments.doneWhen: t-3 passes and the full suite stays green.

tests.description: pageViews helpers: day key, increment, 7-day window.
appStore records a view on load, persists and restores counts.
PageViewsPanel renders 7 rows with counts; HomeView includes the panel.
